scope: M114 lane A: before-state audit; no implementation polish or visual-golden approval

roles.fix: Replace direct --vscode-* reads with matching --ms-* roles; import extended host-role sheet for input/code/syntax/validation roles. Preserve each existing fallback order.
roles.evidence: styles.css body and component selectors; no raw colour survives lane 0, but most roles still bypass tokens.

scale.fix: Replace literal radii/spacing/type/alpha with source scales; radius xs/sm/md/lg/xl/pill/circle and spacing-1…8; use typography and state alpha roles. Preserve geometry constants until owning layout lane approves changes.
scale.evidence: styles.css literal 999px/50%/3px/20px radii, em sizes, font-weight 600, and pixel gaps; generated layout aliases are already present.

states.fix: Supply hover, :focus-visible, :active/pressed, disabled and applicable selected states for each control; no selector in either hand-edited stylesheet currently defines :active. Do not add Tab stops to active-descendant options.
states.evidence: styles.css controls and additions states blocks, whatsNew.css button:hover; selected and some disabled rules exist, pressed rules do not.

focus.fix: Use --ms-focus-width (2 px), --ms-focus-offset and --ms-focus. Check 3:1 on actual neighbours; keep ring outside control fill and unclipped by scrollers/dock/toasts. Host colour failures need a token-contract/owner resolution, not an AA exemption.
focus.evidence: styles.css shared outline:1px and offset:-1px; textarea outline:none; some row-menu controls have 2px rings, but One Dark Pro focus still fails.

motion.fix: Use fast/base/slow 120/180/240 ms and standard/emphasised easing, declared only under no-preference. Remove streamed cursor blink. Resolve decorative activity-loop exceptions explicitly; retain reduced-motion canvas still rendering.
motion.evidence: styles.css blink 1s, pulse/agent-pulse 1.2s, status-mark-expand 4.01s, chevron/toggle 120ms, gooey burst 180ms ease-out; existing reduce block cancels them.

overlay.fix: Use overlay elevation/radius, overlay-only alpha/blur, --ms-contrast-border in HC. Literal modal shadow remains even though token shadow values go flat. HC and reduced transparency must be opaque and shadowless; no control blur.
overlay.evidence: styles.css .modal box-shadow:0 4px 16px var(--vscode-widget-shadow); .modal-backdrop already uses --ms-modal-scrim. Captured default HC computes shadow:none because widget-shadow is unset; the missing explicit token/HC binding remains a source contract gap, not an observed shadow in those captures.

popover.fix: Use popover elevation and contrast border; keep popover transparency separate from opaque controls and clear all shadows in HC/forced colours. Opening motion belongs under no-preference.
popover.evidence: styles.css .mention-menu/.palette/.popover box-shadow:0 2px 8px; .tool-expand 0 1px 4px; no component HC removal. Captured default HC has shadow:none from the unset host shadow; no explicit HC contrast-border migration exists.

approval.fix: Delete @container approval-choices(width < 340px) flex-basis:100%; keep one horizontal decision row with equal height/width/emphasis, readable full labels via title/accessible name, and no stacked buttons at 320 px.
approval.evidence: styles.css .approval-choices > button and narrow container; ApprovalCard chooses primary approvals and secondary rejection.

placeholder.fix: Use a host-role solution that keeps input/placeholder text at 4.5:1 in captured One Dark Pro and Dracula; retain captured theme bytes. Verify disabled content separately, never treat enabled placeholders as disabled.
placeholder.evidence: visual-matrix.json: placeholder/input One Dark Pro 3.604:1; Dracula 3.026:1.

whatsnew.fix: Keep the page root on editor-surface; replace h1/h2/h3/code em sizes and 1.5/1.25 line heights with token roles, use code/link/quote roles and 2 px focus around links/buttons/input/pre.
whatsnew.evidence: whatsNew.css body, h1–h4, pre/code, button and a:focus-visible; no pressed/disabled styles.

inherited.fix: No independent painted surface or interaction state; audit through the named owning child/parent scenes.
inherited.evidence: Component delegates its DOM/states to children or a shared parent.

host-error.fix: Add a distinct host-error foreground mapping in the token source, with its name agreed by lane 0 and captured host AA uses, before migrating this read. Keep input-validation error text, testing failure and chart danger distinct; retain existing fallback order. C must bind the resulting role after the token contract is extended.
host-error.evidence: styles.css .message-error, .context-meter-high, .mic-button.mic-listening, .tool-dot-failed, .tool-failure and other failed-state fallbacks read this variable; no consumers.json.hostRoles entry maps it.

components.fix: Give jump-latest an exterior focus ring and pressed/disabled states; keep the scroll gutter and column inset unchanged.
Tokenize task-window action and heading type/spacing; keep read-only and ended views separately legible at 320 px.
Tokenize agent nodes/result typography and running dot; supply pressed and disabled owner actions and a flat contrast-border modal in HC.

components.fix: Remove the narrow full-width choice rule; use equal size AND equal emphasis on every decision, including Deny, while preserving complete labels for assistive technology.
Tokenize dock spacing/count text; reserve enough scroll padding for a 2 px ring around the last decision; bind any future M112 fold to base motion.
Use xs/md radius and small-text/spacing tokens for filename/size chips; give remove buttons an exterior focus ring and pressed state.
Tokenize numeric/select fields and diff typography; style disabled compare/restore controls and list selections without widening the 320 px form.
Migrate code toolbar and syntax roles to extended tokens; add pressed copy/open states and 2 px scrollable-body focus without animating source text.
Use input, badge, control and type tokens; replace the suppressed textarea outline with a 2 px container ring; preserve single-row toolbar fit and address placeholder contrast.

evidence.declarations:
color: var(--vscode-charts-red, var(--vscode-errorForeground));
  animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;

components.fix: Map track alpha, SVG label sizes and progress/warning/danger roles to tokens; give the ring button 2 px focus and pressed/disabled styling.
Keep the loading-to-report focus handoff; consume the polished DeferredSurface and ReportDialog styles rather than adding a second overlay.
Audit both modal and popover loading fallbacks; use overlay/popover elevation with HC borders and a visible loading-close focus ring.
Tokenize addition/deletion roles and tally spacing; preserve readable deletion fallback and add pressed/disabled Review styling.
Use circle radius, selected accent and disabled tokens for dots; interactive footer dots get visible focus/pressed styles while read-only option dots remain aria-hidden.
Tokenize form labels, error text and input borders; style native field focus/disabled and action pressed states while retaining full-row narrow fields.
Replace brand size/weight and six-pixel gap with typography/spacing tokens; keep the existing unofficial identity and quiet opaque background.
Apply the gate's type and warning-surface tokens to crash diagnostics; give Reload/Report visible focus and pressed/disabled states without relying on the crashed app.
Use info/link-hover/focus roles for links, including citation and code-path contexts; add pressed states and a 2 px ring with an underline as a non-colour cue.
Tokenize hold border, PR fields and checks; add ring/pressed/disabled states to generated commit/PR actions; preserve warnings for held code and 320 px wraps.
Use progress/status/type tokens for objective and budget cells; add focus and pressed/disabled to pause/edit/save controls while preserving unknown status words.
Tokenize bar radius/height/fill and facts typography; keep reported percentage text as the accessible counterpart of the decorative progress fill.
Replace 20 px radius, padding, delay and 180 ms ease-out with scale/motion tokens; keep opaque crisp pills with no shadow/blur; add pressed state and contrast-safe rings.
Tokenize editable brief height/type and action spacing; show input focus and disabled Start/pressed actions without altering the brief-review workflow.
Migrate title, badge/pill radii and header action gaps to tokens; give rename/new/history/board controls pressed and disabled treatment without changing host title bars.
Read --ms-progress in canvas beamColor instead of a VS Code variable; preserve the existing reduced-motion still beat and CanvasText forced-colour branch; token-bind its displayed size.
Use extended syntax-function/keyword/string/number tokens for highlight classes and editor code font/size; preserve text as rendered, without animated syntax spans.
Use popover elevation/radius and token type for session metadata; add focus/pressed/disabled to archive/filter toggles and keep active-descendant row selection readable.
Replace fractional text size and gaps with type/space tokens; retain the advisory status's narrow wrapping and muted contrast on the actual sidebar canvas.
Add an explicit 2 px focus-visible ring to the keyboard-scrollable palette body, with inset padding preventing clipping; preserve its focus-in-filter mouse behaviour.
Tokenize heading/list/quote/code typography and quote border; give links and focusable code scrollers visible rings; keep images and streamed prose opaque and motionless.
Use popover tokens and selected text/background roles; add row hover/pressed treatment while retaining textarea-owned focus and active-descendant announcements.
Style the option's selected/hover/pressed states through its list owner, never turn it into a second Tab stop; keep hidden tooltip descriptions and the combobox focus ring.
Use overlay elevation/alpha and lg radius; remove literal shadow in HC, add contrast border and 2 px close focus; keep focus trap and inert background.
Tokenize card/text/shortcut gaps and radius; add link pressed/focus-visible states, retaining long shortcut wrapping and non-colour keyboard instructions.
Use pill radius and badge/warning role pair; retain the explicit paid word so warning colour is never the only cost cue; do not change consent defaults.
Tokenize groups, switches, radii and thumb travel timing; add pressed/disabled/selected states and 2 px filter focus; preserve the selected detail contrast fix.
Tokenize panel/header/footer and kbd radii, use flat HC borders and guarded popover opening; preserve menu-owned keyboard navigation and 320 px bounds.
Tokenize tabs/input/action roles; give selected tabs non-colour underline plus hover/focus/pressed/disabled styles and native field rings; keep Explain/Other inputs readable.
Consume GooeyMenu's tokens and states for selection actions; keep the menu anchored to highlighted text without blurring pills or shifting the selected prose.
Tokenize reasoning text and disclosure spacing; add 2 px header focus and pressed state; put chevron rotation on fast/standard motion and keep expanded text still.
Tokenize preview code font/size, warning and input roles; add focus/pressed/disabled for export and include switches; preserve read-only scrubbed preview and 320 px action wraps.
Use severity-edge and text tokens without colouring severity words below AA; add location-link rings/pressed states and scale the finding card spacing/radius.
Tokenize hunks/line gutters/comment fields and modal elevation; add selected/pressed/disabled review actions and focus on comment controls; keep long paths wrapped at 320 px.
Tokenize scheduled prompt card/facts/actions; show Resume/Remove focus, pressed and disabled states without changing the existing paid admission policy.
Use polished Modal/input/button roles and warning/quote border; preserve redacted content and equal-sized Send/Edit actions with visible keyboard focus.
Use palette popover tokens and row selection; add filter/create/restore pressed and disabled styles while preserving state/branch/change metadata at 320 px.
Tokenize read-only share sections and metadata; add Show more pressed/disabled/focus styling and keep paged sections from widening the narrow viewport.

components.fix: Tokenize diagnostic/confirmation roles and gate type/gaps; supply ring/pressed/disabled actions for install/sign-in/cancel without changing native host authentication UI.
Map command groups and selected-detail roles to popover tokens; style hover/pressed options through the textarea-owned combobox and retain its existing contrast correction.
Tokenize working-line space/type; preserve the longest-verb reserved cell and non-live decorative trace so verb changes never move streamed text.
Token-bind decorative gradient/size/radius/alpha; classify the 4.01 s breathing loop explicitly as an activity exception requiring owner resolution, since D94 specifies 120–240 ms motion.
Use raised/border/progress/type tokens; give fold/open/window actions 2 px focus and pressed/disabled states, preserving task labels and current-item emphasis.
Tokenize clipped-output elevation, code and diff roles; use an outer rounded wrapper where collapsed table borders ignore radius; add pressed/ring states to expand/open controls.
Migrate every memory/goal/schedule/web/image/workflow body to code/info/muted tokens; preserve image aspect bounds, path overflow and action-link ring/pressed states.
Tokenize step/status/shell roles and chevron timing; remove continuous literal pulse or record an owner exception, add 2 px focus/pressed/disabled on every disclosure and task action.

components.fix: Tokenize message, timestamp, usage, notice and citation subparts; remove streamed cursor blink, add timestamp/disclosure/notice pressed+focus states, preserve row-menu reveal and scroll geometry.
Tokenize account bars/toggles and paid rows; add selected/hover/focus/pressed/disabled to switches and Ask again; flatten modal in HC and preserve visible price/shared budget.
Use code/surface/status tokens for command/output and result; add pressed/disabled and 2 px focus to Stop/Open actions without changing shell text or task semantics.
Tokenize command/diagnostic blocks and success/failure borders; keep explanatory status words and code typography readable on tinted backgrounds, with shared output action rings.
Use text/muted/status/code tokens for each agent and summary; add header/button focus+pressed states and retain complete status words and long-path wrapping.
Keep currentColor for functional icons and tokenized brand paints; use icon size roles consistently and audit every icon through its parent control states, never add blur or icon motion.
Keep mode icons in their owning labelled controls, inheriting functional currentColor and the shared icon sizing token; certify selected mode through text/ARIA, not the glyph alone.
Tokenize search and session-row/badge roles; add pressed/disabled options and 2 px active-descendant owner focus while preserving current-session labels.
Preserve the shared bridge/bootstrap and crash/Tasks mounting; let child surface styles own tokens and keep nonrendered entry logic free of theme literals.
Migrate the separate stylesheet to editor/code/link/control roles and type/space scales; increase 1 px rings to 2 px and supply pressed/disabled actions, with no remote styles/fonts.
